# Synthetic fixtures (MIT)

Generated with scripts/make-fixtures.py using Pillow 12.2 and pillow-heif 1.3.0.
No personal photographs. Four color quadrants and labels reveal orientation.
Includes landscape, portrait HEIF, EXIF orientation 6, sRGB ICC metadata,
4032 × 2688 resolution, and a deliberately truncated HEIC.

These fixtures exercise decoding and output, but do not substitute for actual
photos from different iPhone generations, Display P3, HDR, or device-memory tests.
